text: Whatever happens in this room... don't blink.
SCP-173. A statue. Concrete and rebar, with spray paint on its face.
It cannot move... while someone is looking at it.
So three people go in. Always three. Two watch it. One cleans.
Because the floor... is always stained.
You're one of the two watching. Your eyes start to burn.
It's closer now. And your eyes... are watering.
